title: Tensor.reverse_sequence default arguments are unusable and diverge in Graph mode
duplicate_search_result: No exact matching GitHub or Gitee issue found.
documentation_notes: MindSpore 2.9 official Tensor.reverse_sequence page shows Tensor.reverse_sequence(seq_lengths, seq_dim=0, batch_dim=0).
MindSpore 2.9 official ops.reverse_sequence page shows seq_dim is required, batch_dim defaults to 0, and CPU is supported.
MindSpore 2.9 local Graph standard_method.reverse_sequence(x, seq_lengths, seq_dim, batch_dim=0) does not provide the Tensor method's seq_dim default.
classification_notes: Not a numerical precision issue: the reproducer uses int32 sequence reversal.
Not an unsupported CPU kernel issue: explicit Tensor.reverse_sequence(..., seq_dim=1) and ops.reverse_sequence(..., seq_dim=1) work in Graph mode on CPU.
The default Tensor call is unusable because seq_dim=0 and batch_dim=0 violate the ReverseSequence invariant, while Graph also drops the Tensor method's seq_dim default.
